description.p: Collect class notes, work through equations and sketch ideas in notebooks. Combine typed text and handwriting on the same page, with pictures, tables and shapes.

ul.li: Organize notebooks into sections and pages.
Format text, draw with a mouse or stylus, and use a ruler or protractor.
Search typed notes, handwriting and text in pictures.
Recognize handwritten formulas and work with math tools.
Export pages to PDF and transfer notebooks using Vive files.

description.p: Notebooks are stored locally and can be edited offline. Handwriting and picture text recognition are built in. The UniMERNet Small math recognition model downloads automatically on first run (about 209 MB), and the math runtime also needs an initial download. Other formula recognition models are optional.
Linux desktop version with notebooks, rich text, handwriting and PDF export.
